header.use: Column/row header cell — table/header/background (#ededed) + text/default font-5 medium.

sub-header.use: Secondary header on table/column/background (#f3f3f3) + font-5 light.

data-cell.use: Data cell — background/default (#fff) + text/default font-5 light; right-aligned variant for numbers.

accessibility.semantics: Use real <table> with <th scope='col'/'row'> for headers; both-header tables set scope appropriately so screen readers associate cells with their row+column headers (1.3.1)
accessibility.alignment: Right-align numeric columns for scanning; keep header alignment consistent with its column
accessibility.caption: Provide a <caption> or accessible name describing the table's purpose
accessibility.responsive: CARD-COLLAPSE (Figma 'Version=vertical', node 2137:115845). At narrow container width each row reflows into a card: column headers repeat as grey labels beside each value ([table/header label | background/default value], ~42/58), and a row-header (when present) becomes the card title bar; first-column tables show bare values under the title (no column headers exist). A focusable role=region scroll container still backs the wide form. <th scope> association is preserved in the DOM at every width (1.3.1 + 1.4.10 reflow to 320px).
accessibility.variants: Full matrix from Figma section 65540:46962: headerType {first-row, first-column, first-row-and-column} x orientation {horizontal data-table, vertical card-collapse} x cellAlign {left, right-numeric}; plus a sub-header that shares table/column/background (#F3F3F3 / #1D1D1D) with row headers.
accessibility.type: headers = font-5 medium (500); cell data = font-5 REGULAR (400). NB Figma specs data as light (350) but Univers Light renders too thin in Chrome (Dave, 2026-06-22) — promoted to regular; candidate token-store flag.
accessibility.atSignal: PASSIVE / semantic-table AT (rubric decision A, 2026-06-22 — Dave chose option a). Table is interactive:false: it is a STATIC semantic data table (props headerType/orientation/cellAlign — no sort, no selection), so it earns the AT dimension via <caption> + <th scope> + a focusable scroll region (role=region/tabindex/aria-label), NOT a keyboard widget. Adding sort/selection would change the component's nature and is out of scope; if a sortable table is ever needed it should be a distinct component.

antiPatterns: Using a table for layout rather than tabular data
Omitting scope on header cells (breaks header/data association for AT)

tokenValidation.against: token store re-based on Figma native variable export
tokenValidation.newTokenGroupSeen: table/* — dedicated table tokens: table/header/background (#ededed), table/column/background (#f3f3f3), table/border (#d7d8d6). First component to use them; data cells use background/default + text/default.

depricateUsage.note: None. Fully on table/* + background/default + text/default.
